button.$description: Button component tokens. Most values alias shared foundation/semantic tokens (kept here, per component, for discoverability and ownership reporting); the height ladder is genuinely Button-owned, using its own tighter Tailwind-style scale instead of the shared `control.height.*` tier (per-component height tokens alias the shared family where the values happen to match, as `height.xs` does here).

height.$description: Button's own tighter Tailwind-style height ladder, distinct from the shared `control.height.*` tier.

xs.$description: Extra-small button height (24px), aliasing the shared control-height tier.

toggle.$description: Toggle-track tokens. Single-consumer (toggle.css); encode the dark-arm contrast improvement here so toggle.css uses only var() references and stays theme-guard clean.

off-resting.$description: Toggle track color in the off, resting state. Light arm preserves the `border.muted` look; dark arm raises lightness for >=3:1 shape contrast against the surface.

off-hover-resting.$description: Toggle track color in the off state on hover. Steps up from `off-resting` to be distinguishable.

gap.$description: Gap between the trigger's disclosure icon and label.

action-row.$description: ActionRow default (non-condensed) density tokens. `[data-cinder-density='condensed']` overrides padding-block/padding-inline locally in action-row.css; that variant is a component-owned density state, not a separate corpus token.

column-gap.$description: Grid column gap between leading/body/trailing regions.

row-gap.$description: Grid row gap between leading/body/trailing regions.

body-gap.$description: Gap between title, description, and meta lines.

trailing-gap.$description: Gap between items in the trailing region.

info.$description: Alert `info` tone ring/status-base color, single-consumer (alert.css); encodes the light/dark pair directly here so alert.css stays var()-only.

mobile-bleed.$description: Horizontal bleed a card's mobile layout extends past its container on each side.

carousel.$description: Carousel layout tokens. `slide-size` and `aspect-ratio` have no DTCG-representable dimension shape (a bare percentage and a ratio, not a `{value, unit}` pair) -- `$value` is a nominal numeric placeholder; `cssRecipe` is authoritative for emission. Flagged in the CIN-472 PR body.

slide-size.$description: Slide inline-size as a percentage of the viewport. `$value` (100) is the percentage number, not a dimension -- CSS `100%` has no DTCG dimension representation.

aspect-ratio.$description: Slide aspect ratio (16:9). `$value` is the ratio as a number (16/9); `cssRecipe` emits the exact `16 / 9` CSS `aspect-ratio` syntax.

background.$description: Code surface background. Light arm MUST stay pure `surface-raised` (not `surface-inset`) -- Shiki's github-light token colors measure their AA contrast against that surface with almost no margin; darkening it fails the axe sweep. See code-block.css for the full rationale. Dark arm uses `surface-inset` for the deeper github-dark ground.

height.$description: Block height. Real value is CSS `auto` (intrinsic content height); DTCG's dimension type has no keyword form, so `$value` is a non-authoritative placeholder and `cssRecipe` governs emission. Flagged in the CIN-472 PR body as a type-system limitation, not a design decision.

rail-size.$description: Rail marker box size (width and height).

scroll-edge.$description: Horizontal scroll-edge fade gradient color -- `text-default` at 12% opacity, tracking whichever theme arm resolves.

marquee.$description: Marquee layout/timing tokens. `--cinder-marquee-play-state` is deliberately NOT modeled here -- it is the component's own hover/focus/manual-pause/ready state channel (a CSS custom property used as lightweight state wiring, not a theming knob), and its four declarations in marquee.css are marked `@runtime-state`.

duration.$description: Default scroll duration for one full loop.

backdrop.$description: `::backdrop` fill color override point. See modal.css for why this is declared once, non-self-referentially, on `.cinder-modal` -- a consumer override must target `::backdrop` directly for cross-engine reliability.

selectable-row.$description: SelectableRow default (non-condensed) density tokens. `.cinder-selectable-row--condensed` overrides padding-block/padding-inline locally in selectable-row.css; that variant is a component-owned density state, not a separate corpus token.

column-gap.$description: Gap between the row's leading/primary/trailing regions.

leading-gap.$description: Gap between the leading control and label.

spinner.$description: Spinner default (unsized, `md`) tokens. `[data-cinder-size='sm'|'md'|'lg']` locally override `size` per variant in spinner.css, the same way Button's own height ladder is component-owned rather than aliased to the shared `control.height.*` tier.

indicator.$description: Spinner arc color. Default is `currentColor` (inherits from context); the reduced-motion static state re-asserts the same track-color fallback explicitly. `$value` aliases `text.default` as the closest resolvable stand-in for `currentColor`'s typical resolution.

column-gap.$description: Gap between statistic columns when laid out inline.

gap.$description: Gap between the change indicator icon and its label.

statistic-group.$description: StatisticGroup default (card layout) tokens. The shared-border layout mode overrides `gap` to `1px` locally in statistic-group.css to create hairline dividers between cells; that variant is a component-owned layout mode, not a separate corpus token.

shared-cell-padding.$description: Padding inside each cell in the shared-border layout mode.

status-dot.$description: StatusDot default (unstatused, `md`) tokens. `[data-cinder-status='*']` and `[data-cinder-size='sm'|'md']` locally override `color`/`size` per variant in status-dot.css -- component-owned state, not separate corpus tokens.

color.$description: Dot fill color (default, no status set).

tree.$description: Tree drag-and-drop indicator tokens. `drop-line-color` switches to the `Highlight` system color under `forced-colors: active` -- a standard accessibility fallback kept local to tree.css, not a separate corpus token.

item-dragging-opacity.$description: Opacity of an item's row while being dragged.
